chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
If there is healing in anything, it is in the phlebotomy lancet and in drinks made of honey.

key_terms.شَرطَةِ حَجَّامٍ: the lancet of a bloodletter (phlebotomy lancet)

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet say about healing in honey and bloodletting?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this Prophetic tradition underscores the medical wisdom of the Ahl al-Bayt by validating hijamah (bloodletting) and honey as premier therapeutic agents. It reflects the Shia emphasis on integrating spiritual purity with practical health, positioning these natural remedies as divinely sanctioned means of restoring bodily balance.
